character: vain mink, glossy dark-brown fur, rich sheepskin coat embroidered red, blue and yellow, tall black fur papakha, smug, always in motion
props: picket fence at the yard's far edge, two pickets set wide apart, intact all clip; smoking grill with shashlik and skewers; torn strips of sheepskin; five scruffy half-rats - lean father, fat mother, three kids, patchy dull fur - all on her side from 0.3
motion_rule: two or more rats ride the mink's body every window, never on or behind the fence until 9.5; she fights back every window - wrenching, kicking, elbowing, spinning them off - never merely walking; new spot and shot size every window; one more piece of the coat lost every window
environment: snowy backyard, bright sunny midday, hard shadows

audio.delivery: smug female voice, native Russian stress, calm
audio.pronunciation: stress: shi-KAR-ny, no-SHU, se-BYA, GLAV-no-ye in three clear syllables, sa-SYE-di, za-VEE-do-va-li - never ZA-vi-do-va-li
audio.pacing: brisk lively pacing, no drawling, lines fit the windows
audio.lip_sync: mouth moves on every syllable, never a voice-over
audio.sfx: snow crunch, teeth clacking, tearing cloth, squeaks

timeline.a: all five rats vault the fence and land on the mink mid-stride, she staggers
mink wrenches the coat open, dark fur blazing at the lens, shakes a kid off her wrist | mother rides her shoulder, father swings from the papakha
mink ploughs forward kicking a kid off her boot | two rats grip the hem in their teeth and drag behind, heels digging in
mink spins hard, coat flying out in a full circle | both rats fly off into the snowbank, embroidery ripping loose in their teeth
mink elbows father off her chest | falling, he rips the skewers from her paw with a strip of the hem
mink hauls right to left leaning into the weight | mother bites the papakha and pulls back, three kids piled on the tail, the family skidding behind her
mink leaps a snowbank, coat and fur fanning mid-air | the papakha rips loose in mother's teeth, kids on the tail dragged with her
mother's snarling muzzle fills the lens, bared teeth, skewer in her fist, papakha fur in her mouth | mink shrinks back
all five launch in one heap and bury the mink, the coat vanishing under bodies
the heap thrashes, torn sheepskin and papakha fluff spraying into the lens
mink's paw shoots from the heap gripping a strip, mother yanks it back, it snaps between them
mink tears free bare-furred, shreds trailing, scrabbling backwards to the fence, two kids on her tail
mink squeezes between the two wide pickets, whining, ribs scraping, boards bowing, kids shaken off
mink drops on her own side, back to the fence, panting | beyond it the rats fight over the shreds, mother pulling a strip over her head

must_appear: skewers taken at 3.3; family dragged behind her at 4.05; bared teeth filling the lens at 6.55; coat in shreds 7.05-8.55; mink between the pickets at 9.05; fence intact every frame
negative_prompt: night, dark scene, dusk, evening, subtitles, captions, watermark, static camera, same shot size twice, only her head moving, rats on the fence before 9.5, a gap between mink and rats, a window where the rats do nothing, the mink walking calmly, the fence breaking, blood, wounds, extra limbs, character changing mid-shot, English speech, Latin letters, any word after 6.55
